question: Who was posthumously awarded the Dadasaheb Phalke Award at the 65th National Film Awards?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Vinod Khanna**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Vinod Khanna** was posthumously awarded the Dadasaheb Phalke Award at the 65th National Film Awards.
 
• The Dadasaheb Phalke Award is India's highest award in cinema, presented annually at the National Film Awards ceremony by the Directorate of Film Festivals, an organization set up by the Ministry of Information and Broadcasting.
 
• It is given to individuals for their outstanding contribution to the growth and development of Indian cinema.
 
• Vinod Khanna was a prominent actor in Indian cinema, known for his performances in numerous films during the 1970s and 1980s.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Dadasaheb Phalke Award was instituted in 1969, the birth centenary year of Dadasaheb Phalke, who is considered the father of Indian cinema.
 
• The award comprises a Swarna Kamal (Golden Lotus) medallion, a shawl, and a cash prize.
 
• Vinod Khanna's illustrious career spanned over four decades, with notable films such as "Mere Apne," "Mera Gaon Mera Desh," "Amar Akbar Anthony," "Muqaddar Ka Sikandar," and "The Burning Train."
 
• He also served as a Member of Parliament and was a respected politician.
